title: Sensor-Set Conditioning for Prognostic Posterior Consistency
description: Versioned reproducibility archive for the analysis code and frozen evaluation artifacts. The current branch temporarily withholds the manuscript source and contains the formal protocol and claim-metric contracts, frozen thresholds and decision snapshots, compact calibration and C-MAPSS shared-model results, and the scripts needed to regenerate the compact analyses. The primary study uses a controlled synthetic benchmark with exact oracle posteriors; C-MAPSS FD001 is included as a public simulated benchmark and is not presented as field validation. Raw C-MAPSS files, large prediction stores, and private checkpoints are excluded.
notes: This metadata describes the code-only v0.2.1 release. The historical v0.2.0 tag includes the manuscript source and should not be published while that source is withheld. Select the final code license in the Zenodo deposit form when the repository is ready for archival.
